news.title: Inside the life of Kadeisha Buchanan
news.title_zh: 卡黛莎·布坎南的生活内部
news.body_en: Kadeisha Buchanan fills us in on her footballing journey and how she likes to spend her time behind the scenes. Could you start by telling us where you grew up and what it was like? I grew up in Toronto and Brampton. So, rough areas, but it was good fun. What age did you start playing football? What was the name of your first grassroots team? Who has been the biggest influence on your football career to date? I'd say my peers, my team-mates. What's been your career highlight to date? Who are your best friends in football?Shanice van de Sanden and Lauren James. Could you name your top three favourite players of all time? Christine Sinclair, Ronaldinho and Marta. What do you like to do away from football? How do you switch off?Reading and having a nap. Are you watching any TV series currently?I've just started Grey's Anatomy from the beginning. If we looked at your Spotify playlist, who's dominating your most played artists of the year?Rod Wave. What are your top three holiday destinations, either that you’ve been to or want to visit?Jamaica, Turks and Caicos, and Greece. If you had guests over for dinner, what would you cook for them?Ooh. Let's see... I'd make jerk chicken wings. Tell the fans something they might not know about you...Maybe that both of my parents are Jamaican. What's the best piece of advice you've ever received?Work hard even when no one's watching. Finally, what does football mean to you?
news.body_zh: 卡黛莎·布坎南 (Kadeisha Buchanan) 向我们讲述了她的足球之旅以及她喜欢在幕后度过的时光。您能首先告诉我们您在哪里长大以及是什么样的吗？我在多伦多和布兰普顿长大。所以，虽然地方很艰苦，但很有趣。您几岁开始踢足球？你的第一个草根团队叫什么名字？迄今为止，谁对您的足球生涯影响最大？我会说我的同龄人，我的队友。迄今为止，您的职业生涯亮点是什么？谁是你在足球界最好的朋友？沙尼丝·范·德·桑登和劳伦·詹姆斯。你能说出你最喜欢的三名球员吗？克里斯蒂娜·辛克莱、罗纳尔迪尼奥和玛塔。足球之外你喜欢做什么？你如何关闭？阅读和小睡。你现在在看什么电视剧吗？我刚刚从头开始看《实习医生格蕾》。如果我们查看一下您的 Spotify 播放列表，谁在您年度播放次数最多的艺术家中占据主导地位？Rod Wave。您去过或想去的三大度假胜地是哪？牙买加、特克斯和凯科斯群岛以及希腊。如果你有客人来吃晚饭，你会为他们做什么？哦。让我们看看...我会做混蛋鸡翅。告诉粉丝一些他们可能不知道的关于你的事情……也许我的父母都是牙买加人。您收到过的最好的建议是什么？即使没有人在场，也要努力工作。最后，足球对你来说意味着什么？

news.title: Bookings now open for Museum & Tours’ new VR adventure: Mission Into the Blue
news.title_zh: Museum & Tours 的全新 VR 冒险之旅现已开放预订：Mission Into the Blue
news.body_en: A brand-new adventure has landed at Stamford Bridge, and bookings are now officially open. Chelsea FC Museum & Tours is inviting fans to experience Mission: Into the Blue, an immersive virtual reality adventure that takes visitors beyond Stamford Bridge and into a whole new dimension. Taking Chelsea fans from SW6 and beyond, Mission: Into the Blue uses immersive VR technology to offer an exciting new way to experience the world of Chelsea. Designed for fans of all ages, it brings together imagination, innovation and Chelsea pride in a unique interactive adventure. Step into your mission, immerse yourself in a new virtual world and create unforgettable memories long after the headset comes off. Powered by Location-Based Virtual Reality (LBVR), the experience brings the physical and virtual worlds together. Unlike traditional VR, participants can move freely through the space, explore their surroundings and interact with the virtual environment in real time, making them part of the action rather than simply watching it unfold. And it is an adventure designed to be shared. Multiple participants can enter the experience together, see one another represented within the virtual world and take on the mission side by side, making Mission: Into the Blue perfect for families, friends and Chelsea fans of all ages. Behind the adventure is a combination of spatial computing, computer vision, sensors, cameras and real-time 3D technology, seamlessly connecting the physical space at Stamford Bridge with the digital world inside the headset. For Chelsea supporters, it offers an entirely new way to connect with the club. Rather than simply watching Chelsea content, fans can step inside a club-inspired world, explore it, interact with it and become part of the story. Mission: Into the Blue can be added to the popular Stadium Tour, bringing a completely new dimension to a visit to Stamford Bridge, or booked as a standalone experience. Whether you are a lifelong Blue, planning a family day out or experiencing Stamford Bridge for the first time, Mission: Into the Blue is an unmissable new adventure waiting to be discovered. Bookings are officially open. Your mission starts now.
news.body_zh: 一场全新的冒险登陆斯坦福桥，现已正式开放预订。切尔西足球俱乐部博物馆和旅游 (Chelsea FC Museum & Tours) 邀请球迷体验《使命：进入蓝色》(Mission: Into the Blue)，这是一场身临其境的虚拟现实冒险，带领游客走出斯坦福桥，进入一个全新的维度。 《Mission: Into the Blue》以 SW6 及其他地区的切尔西球迷为主角，采用沉浸式 VR 技术，提供了一种令人兴奋的新方式来体验切尔西的世界。它专为各个年龄段的球迷而设计，在独特的互动冒险中将想象力、创新和切尔西的自豪感融为一体。踏入您的使命，沉浸在全新的虚拟世界中，在摘下耳机后仍能留下难忘的回忆。在基于位置的虚拟现实 (LBVR) 的支持下，这种体验将物理世界和虚拟世界融合在一起。与传统 VR 不同，参与者可以在空间中自由移动、探索周围环境并与虚拟环境实时交互，使他们成为动作的一部分，而不仅仅是观看动作的展开。这是一次旨在分享的冒险。多个参与者可以一起进入体验，在虚拟世界中看到彼此的代表，并肩并肩执行任务，使《使命：走进蓝色》非常适合各年龄段的家人、朋友和切尔西球迷。冒险背后是空间计算、计算机视觉、传感器、摄像头和实时 3D 技术的结合，将斯坦福桥的物理空间与耳机内的数字世界无缝连接起来。对于切尔西球迷来说，它提供了一种与俱乐部联系的全新方式。球迷们不仅仅是观看切尔西的内容，还可以走进一个受俱乐部启发的世界，探索它，与之互动并成为故事的一部分。使命：进入蓝色可以添加到受欢迎的体育场之旅中，为斯坦福桥之旅带来全新的维度，也可以作为独立体验进行预订。无论您是终生的蓝队成员、计划全家出游还是第一次体验斯坦福桥，《使命：走进蓝队》都是一场不容错过的新冒险，等待着您去发现。正式开放预订。你的使命现在开始。

news.title: Chelsea duo nominated for Golden Boy award
news.title_zh: 切尔西二人组获得金童奖提名
news.body_en: Estevao Willian and Jorrel Hato have the honour of being nominated for the 2026 Golden Boy award after an impressive year with both the Blues and their national teams. The prize recognises Europe's best young players each year, with the Blues pair joining 18 others on the list of nominees for 2026. Hato has established himself in the Netherlands set-up, helping his nation reach the round of 32 at this summer's FIFA World Cup, before returning to the Blues and becoming a regular under Xabi Alonso this season. The defender's form has rightly earned him recognition as one of the very best young players in the world. Joining him on that elite list is Estevao, who has featured in all bar one of our matches so far this season. After a fine first campaign for the Blues following his move from Palmeiras, the Brazilian international has become a regular for the Selecao under our former boss Carlo Ancelotti. He has scored six goals in his 14 international appearances, and his strong domestic and international form has earned him a well-deserved Golden Boy nomination. news.title: Vote for Chelsea’s September Goal of the Month
news.title_zh: 投票选出切尔西九月最佳进球
news.body_en: With Chelsea's first game of October approaching, it is time to have your say on the Blues' best strike of the previous month, with 10 fine goals on our shortlist for you to choose from. Despite the extended international break which is only now coming to an end, there were still four men’s fixtures in September in addition to our Academy sides' games, and plenty of goals across those teams. Seven of men's team goals have made our shortlist for the September Chelsea Goal of the Month award, along with two by Cobham Next Gen and one from the Under-18s. Now it is time for you to pick the winner. You can watch all 10 of the nominees back again to refresh your memory in the video above, before casting your vote for your favourite on the Chelsea Official App, where the winner will be revealed soon. It was a flying start from the Blues as we opened the scoring inside two minutes. Jorrel Hato kept a Reece James free-kick alive – his header bouncing invitingly towards Rogers on the edge of the area. The England international didn’t need a second invitation, sweeping a first-time shot low and into the bottom corner. Two minutes after reducing our deficit, Palmer levelled the contest at Stamford Bridge. He made it look simple, as Rogers steered a long throw into the path of the Blues' No.10, who expertly guided a 20-yard finish into the corner. Palmer and Rogers were involved again, as the former played a pass through to the latter, who on the slide guided the ball toward Neto. The Portuguese winger ran onto it and measured his shot, which clipped the far post and nestled in the net to give us the lead. Welbeck got our fourth of the game and this was the first of his two goals against Leeds. He collected a low cross, shifted the ball onto his right foot, evaded two challenges and fired between the goalkeeper’s legs. With 10 minutes remaining, Barco netted his first goal for Chelsea and the Blues’ fifth of the night. Another powerful Rogers run and cross created it, his delivery breaking kindly to the midfielder, who slammed home to seal our progress to the Carabao Cup fifth round. Having put us ahead late in the first half from the penalty spot, Watson extended Chelsea’s lead in the 72nd minute, with his excellent free-kick clipping the post on its way in. Hull arrived at the Bridge having not conceded this season, but it took Rogers just seven minutes to change that. Palmer collected possession and fed a pass into the feet of Joao Pedro. The Brazilian turned and moved the ball to Rogers, who shifted it onto his left foot and drove a near-post shot beyond Konstantinos Tzolakis. Palmer claimed the assist as he drove down the Blues' left flank and crossed low for Joao Pedro. The ball was slightly behind the Brazilian, yet he readjusted expertly and drilled a left-footed finish into the roof of the net. Having been caught by a challenge when racing clear on goal – resulting in a Bournemouth red card – Dako dusted himself down and took responsibility for the resulting free-kick, thumping a right-footed effort into the top-left corner, on our way to a 5-0 win. Bettoni’s equaliser seven minutes into the second half set us on our way to a comeback victory over our neighbours. Chizaram Ezenwata showed good awareness to feed Watson, who squared the ball for Bettoni to stroke a left-footed finish into the net.
news.body_zh: 随着切尔西十月第一场比赛的临近，是时候对蓝军上个月的最佳进球发表意见了，我们的候选名单上有 10 个精彩进球供您选择。尽管延长的国际比赛日刚刚结束，但除了我们青训队的比赛之外，9 月份仍然有四场男子比赛，并且这些球队都有很多进球。男子团队的 7 个进球已入围 9 月份切尔西月度进球奖的候选名单，此外还有 Cobham Next Gen 的 2 个进球和 18 岁以下青年队的 1 个进球。现在是您选出获胜者的时候了。您可以在上面的视频中再次观看所有 10 名提名者，以刷新您的记忆，然后在切尔西官方应用程序上为您最喜欢的人投票，获胜者很快就会揭晓。蓝军取得了良好的开局，两分钟内我们就率先破门。乔雷尔·哈托（Jorrel Hato）保住了里斯·詹姆斯（Reece James）的任意球——他的头球诱人地弹向禁区边缘的罗杰斯（Rogers）。这位英格兰国脚不需要第二次邀请，第一次低射入网底角。在缩小比分差距两分钟后，帕尔默在斯坦福桥扳平了比分。他让这一切看起来很简单，罗杰斯将一记长传投向蓝军10号球员的路线，后者熟练地将20码的射门射入角落。帕尔默和罗杰斯再次参与其中，前者将球传给后者，后者在滑行中将球引向内托。葡萄牙边锋跑上前，测量射门，射门击中远门柱，入网，帮助我们取得领先。维尔贝克打进了本场比赛的第四个进球，这是他对阵利兹联的两个进球中的第一个。他接到一个低传中，将球转移到右脚，避开了两次挑战，并在守门员的两腿之间射门。比赛还剩 10 分钟时，巴科打进了他为切尔西的第一个进球，也是蓝军当晚的第五个进球。罗杰斯的另一次强力跑动和传中创造了机会，他的传球巧妙地传给了中场球员，中场球员大力射门帮助我们晋级卡拉宝杯第五轮。上半场末段，沃森通过点球帮助我们取得领先，他在第 72 分钟扩大了切尔西的领先优势，他出色的任意球击中了门柱。赫尔城本赛季没有失球，但罗杰斯只用了 7 分钟就改变了这一状况。帕尔默夺回控球权，并将球传给若奥·佩德罗脚下。巴西人转身将球传给罗杰斯，罗杰斯将球转移到左脚，近门柱射门越过了康斯坦丁诺斯·佐拉基斯。帕尔默在蓝军左翼突破并低传给若奥·佩德罗时获得了助攻。球稍稍落后于巴西人，但他熟练地重新调整，左脚射门入网。达科在冲向球门时遭遇挑战，结果被伯恩茅斯红牌罚下，他重新掸起身上的灰尘，承担起任意球的责任，右脚射入左上角，最终我们以 5-0 获胜。下半场开始七分钟，贝托尼扳平比分，帮助我们逆转战胜邻国。奇扎拉姆·埃森瓦塔（Chizaram Ezenwata）表现出了良好的意识，为沃森（Watson）喂球，沃森将球摆正，贝托尼（Bettoni）左脚射门入网。

news.title: Eden Hazard special voted Chelsea's Ultimate Goal of the Season
news.title_zh: 艾登·阿扎尔特别评选切尔西赛季最佳进球
news.body_en: Eden Hazard's spectacular solo strike against Arsenal has been chosen by Chelsea supporters as the very best of our Goal of the Season winners. Around two-thirds of Blues fans voted for the Belgian's effort over Michael Essien's long-range rocket against the same opposition a decade earlier. With the most Goal of the Season awards to his name - three - it is fitting that Hazard has taken the crown for the best of the bunch during a competition which has run on the Chelsea Official App throughout the international break. Hazard's goal progressed from a tough group which included Essien's volley against Barcelona and Ramires' own jinking effort, in a win over Man City, before knocking out another of the Belgian's greatest Chelsea goals - the solo strike at Anfield in September 2018. Hazard then beat Moises Caicedo's halfway line strike against Bournemouth in the semis before getting the better of Essien in the grand final. A worthy winner, and a goal we will simply never tire of watching! Congratulations, Eden.
news.body_zh: 埃登·阿扎尔对阵阿森纳的精彩个人进球被切尔西球迷评选为我们赛季最佳进球得主。大约三分之二的蓝军球迷投票支持比利时人的努力，而不是十年前迈克尔·埃辛对阵同一对手的远程火箭。阿扎尔获得了本赛季进球数最多的奖项（三项），在整个国际比赛日期间在切尔西官方应用程序上进行的比赛中，阿扎尔获得了最佳进球奖，这是理所应当的。阿扎尔的进球是在艰难的小组赛中取得的，其中包括埃辛对阵巴塞罗那的凌空抽射和拉米雷斯在战胜曼城的比赛中的精彩射门，然后淘汰了比利时人在切尔西的另一个最伟大的进球——2018年9月在安菲尔德的单刀破门。随后阿扎尔在半决赛中击败了莫伊塞斯·凯塞多在对阵伯恩茅斯的中线射门，然后在决赛中击败了埃辛。一个当之无愧的胜利者，一个我们永远不会厌倦观看的进球！恭喜，伊登。

news.title: Lavia claims assist but Belgium beaten by Lacroix's France
news.title_zh: 拉维亚声称助攻，但比利时队被拉克鲁瓦的法国队击败
news.body_en: An excellent Romeo Lavia assist proved only a footnote for Belgium against Maxence Lacroix's France, as Les Bleus recorded a 4-1 Nations League victory after an impressive second-half fightback. Both Lavia and Lacroix started the Group A fixture at the Stade de France, with Blues goalkeeper Mike Penders an unused substitute for Belgium. France carried a greater threat throughout the contest, but the visitors broke the deadlock with ten minutes of the first half remaining. Lavia created the goal with an excellent, defence-splitting pass that enabled Dodi Lukebakio to run through and confidently convert. As the second half progressed, Belgium frustrated the home side. But when Desire Doue equalised with 13 minutes to play, the floodgates opened. Rayan Cherki quickly netted France's second to put the hosts ahead, before Michael Olise struck a late brace to complete France's late turnaround. Lacroix completed the 90 minutes for France while Lavia was replaced late on as Belgium searched for a route back into the contest they were unable to find. Earlier in the day, a trio of young Blues featured as England Under-19s finished off their September-October fixtures against Belgium. Goalkeeper Freddy Bernal started for England alongside midfielder Reggie Walsh, who is currently on loan at Wigan Athletic. Chelsea forward Chizaram Ezenwata was introduced as a second-half substitute, but England fell to a narrow 1-0 defeat after a stoppage-time strike.

news.title: Analysis: How Chelsea broke through West Ham's low block
news.title_zh: 分析：切尔西如何突破西汉姆联的低位封堵
news.body_en: After Wednesday night's defensive heroics against eight-time Women's Champions League winners Lyon, Chelsea head coach Sonia Bompastor faced a tight turnaround to prepare her side for a test away at West Ham United on Sunday. Bompastor mentioned the difficulties of facing 'many fixtures, big games, and also a lot of travel' during this first block of matches before the international break, and with Sunday's fixture the last of four games in the space of 11 days, a 3-0 victory was something to be celebrated. It could so easily have been different. The match at the Chigwell Construction Stadium was preceded by a tough 1-0 win over Arsenal at Stamford Bridge and the aforementioned 0-0 away at Lyon. Those who watched both of those contests will have seen our players collapse in a heap at the final whistle; such was the gargantuan effort needed to secure those points. And with international games in sight for almost all of our players, it would've been so easy to underestimate the opposition and take one eye off the ball. It was another huge lift from players who had physically given their all, and we avoided the potential banana skin to take maximum points. Here's a look at how we did it... The Hammers finished 10th out of 12 teams in the Women's Super League last season, earning just 19 points from 22 games. It may be that they recognised the potential gulf when it came to this fixture, setting up in an ultra-defensive shape to try and neutralise our attacking threats. With all 11 players behind the ball – as the graphic below shows – it seems like a fairly extreme way to approach the contest from head coach Rita Guarino. The lack of even one outfield player left higher up the pitch to be alive to any potential counter-attacking opportunities meant that West Ham finished the match with no shots on goal and not even a single touch in our box, becoming the first WSL team to have failed to do so in the last ten years of the competition. But there was perhaps method in the madness. After our intense physical battles against Arsenal and Lyon, it stands to reason that we could've turned up in Dagenham with high levels of fatigue, and perhaps the Hammers coach saw the opportunity to make things really difficult and take a point from high-level opponents. And it did take a fine finish from Melvine Malard after 38 energy-sapping minutes to break the deadlock, while the second and third goals weren't scored until 80' and 87'. It's a tactic that could've paid off if it wasn't for Chelsea's determination and resilience that we have seen throughout the course of the new campaign. It's now been nine hours since the Blues last conceded a goal in all competitions. While the six consecutive clean sheets are the result of a whole-team effort, the backline has played a key role in keeping the opposition at bay. Against West Ham, Bompastor selected the same back three that had been so successful against Lyon: Lucy Bronze, Kadeisha Buchanan and Veerle Buurman. All three played a role in the victory over West Ham, and with the opposition's aversion to attacking, their defending became more about winning the ball back to regain possession rather than making last-ditch attempts to extinguish any genuine threats. Bronze stood out in particular on this occasion, winning four of her six tackles in both halves of the pitch, as indicated in the graphic above, and making the most passes of any Chelsea player with 75. This was another game where Keira Walsh stood out for an exceptional performance in her more advanced role. Last season, it took the midfielder 2117 minutes of action in the WSL and UWCL to score two goals; this season it has taken her just 560 to net twice in those competitions, excluding our two-legged qualifier against Real Sociedad. What's changed? It's been well documented that Walsh has been able to get forward more since the emergence of Lexi Potter from the Chelsea Academy. The 20-year-old is comfortable in the holding midfielder role that Walsh has traditionally occupied, and the West Ham game shows how she makes a difference to her more experienced counterpart. Potter did not start against West Ham, and in the first half Walsh took one shot and made 37 passes in the absence of her young sidekick. Bompastor then switched Potter for Sjoeke Nusken at half-time, unlocking the newly adventurous Walsh as she made four shots, scoring once, and with less responsibility as a playmaker made six fewer passes (31) than she had done in the opening 45 minutes. Walsh isn't the only player to have made a shift in the new season. A look at Wieke Kaptein's stats against West Ham shows that she created the most chances of any Chelsea player with six, attempted the most crosses (five), completed the third-most passes in the final third of the pitch (18) and made the joint-most ball recoveries (alongside Bronze with six). She completed all of these unselfish actions without taking a single shot on goal. Watching the 21-year-old in action shows she is focused on helping the team at any given opportunity. Kaptein has fully bought into Bompastor's shift to a team-first mentality, and a look at her WSL metrics for this season in the graphic above reveals how useful she has been to the side so far this term.
news.body_zh: 周三晚上对阵八届女足欧冠冠军里昂队的比赛中，切尔西队主教练索尼娅·邦帕斯特在防守上表现出色，随后她面临着一场严峻的转变，为周日客场挑战西汉姆联队做好准备。邦帕斯托提到，在国际比赛日之前的第一轮比赛中，面临“许多比赛、大型比赛和大量旅行”的困难，而周日的比赛是11天内四场比赛中的最后一场，3-0的胜利是值得庆祝的。它很容易就会有所不同。这场在奇格韦尔建筑体育场举行的比赛之前，阿森纳在斯坦福桥以 1-0 艰难获胜，并在客场以 0-0 战胜了里昂。那些看过这两场比赛的人都会看到我们的球员在终场哨响时倒在地上。为了获得这些分数，需要付出巨大的努力。由于我们几乎所有球员都即将参加国际比赛，因此很容易低估对手并忽视球。这是球员们全力以赴的又一次巨大提升，我们避免了潜在的香蕉皮事件，从而获得了最高分。让我们来看看我们是如何做到的...上赛季，铁锤队在女超联赛的 12 支球队中排名第 10，在 22 场比赛中仅获得 19 分。也许他们在这场比赛中认识到了潜在的鸿沟，因此采取了超防守的阵型，试图消除我们的进攻威胁。如下图所示，所有 11 名球员都在球后，这似乎是主教练丽塔·瓜里诺 (Rita Guarino) 处理比赛的一种相当极端的方式。甚至没有一名外场球员留在前场抓住任何潜在的反击机会，这意味着西汉姆联队在比赛结束时没有射门，甚至没有在禁区内触球，成为近十年来第一支未能做到这一点的球队。但疯狂中或许也有方法。在我们与阿森纳和里昂进行了激烈的身体对抗之后，理所当然地，我们可能会带着高度疲劳出现在达格纳姆，也许铁锤队教练看到了让事情变得非常困难的机会，并从高水平的对手那里拿走了一分。在耗费体力的 38 分钟后，梅尔文·马拉德 (Melvine Malard) 的精彩射门打破了僵局，而第二个和第三个进球直到第 80 分钟和第 87 分钟才进球。如果不是我们在新赛季中看到的切尔西的决心和韧性，这种策略本可以得到回报。距离蓝军上次在所有比赛中失球已经过去九个小时了。虽然连续六场不失球是全队共同努力的结果，但后防线在阻止对手方面发挥了关键作用。对阵西汉姆联队时，邦帕斯托选择了与里昂队相同的三名后卫：露西·布朗泽、卡德伊沙·布坎南和维尔勒·布尔曼。三人都在战胜西汉姆联的比赛中发挥了作用，由于对手厌恶进攻，他们的防守更多地是为了夺回球权以重新获得控球权，而不是做出最后的努力来消除任何真正的威胁。布隆兹在这场比赛中表现尤其突出，如上图所示，她在球场上下半场的六次铲球中赢得了四次，并以 75 次传球成为切尔西球员中传球次数最多的球员。这是另一场凯拉·沃尔什 (Keira Walsh) 在更高级的角色中表现出色的另一场比赛。上赛季，这位中场球员在WSL和UWCL比赛中出场2117分钟，打入两球；本赛季，她在这些比赛中只打进了 560 粒进球，不包括对阵皇家社会的两回合预选赛。发生了什么变化？有充分证据表明，自从切尔西青训学院的莱克西·波特出现后，沃尔什已经能够取得更多进步。这位 20 岁的球员在沃尔什传统上担任的后腰位置上表现得很出色，而与西汉姆联队的比赛表明了她如何对更有经验的对手产生影响。波特在对阵西汉姆联的比赛中没有首发，上半场沃尔什在年轻搭档缺席的情况下只射门一次并传球 37 次。 半场结束时，邦帕斯托将波特换成了斯乔克·努斯肯，释放了新来的冒险家沃尔什，她投篮四次，得分一球，作为组织核心的责任更少，传球次数比开场 45 分钟少了 6 次（31 次）。沃尔什并不是唯一一个在新赛季做出转变的球员。维克·卡普坦对阵西汉姆联的数据显示，她创造了 6 次机会，是所有切尔西球员中最多的，尝试传中次数最多（5 次），在球场最后三分之一完成传球次数第三多（18 次），并且抢回球数并列最多（与青铜队并列，有 6 次）。她完成了所有这些无私的举动，没有一次射正。从这位 21 岁的球员的表现可以看出，她专注于抓住任何给定的机会帮助球队。卡普坦完全接受了 Bompastor 向团队至上心态的转变，从上图中她本赛季的 WSL 指标可以看出她本赛季到目前为止对球队的贡献有多大。

news.title: Harry Hudson reflects on Cobham Next Gen's impressive start to the season
news.title_zh: 哈里·哈德森 (Harry Hudson) 回顾科巴姆下一代 (Cobham Next Gen) 本赛季令人印象深刻的开局
news.body_en: The first international break of the season provided Cobham Next Gen head coach Harry Hudson with a chance to review the campaign so far and look ahead to upcoming challenges across various competitions. Cobham Next Gen have enjoyed a promising start to 2026/27, having won their last three league games and with EFL Trophy progression still on the cards. The squad have been flying high, with six players finding the back of the net already. As a result of Chelsea’s superb form, three players were nominated for the Premier League 2 Player of the Month award for September. Reggie Watson, Chizaram Ezenwata and new signing Leo Black were among the eight nominees. The 3-1 victory over local rivals Fulham before the pause for international football extended CNG's winning streak to three matches, leaving the Blues with nine points and in fourth position. Reflecting on the opening stages of the campaign, Hudson said: ‘It’s been a very positive start for the boys. The longer we’ve had the CNG group together, the more cohesive the performances have become. ‘Our performance against Fulham was very strong. The boys stayed strong, committed and focused on the game plan. A couple of goals were outstanding team goals which was very pleasing for us. The group are coming together with each performance, so long may that continue.’ The CNG squad features several younger players stepping up from Under-18s. Hudson revealed the reason behind this is due to our ‘fantastic talent that we want to be push and deserve to be pushed’. The head coach added: ‘They are learning very fast and the longer they play at this level, the better they’ll become and the quicker they will learn. We’re really proud of how much talent we have in the building. They have a good balance of talent and hard work.’ This season, the September and October international breaks have been merged into one 16-day period, running from 21 September to 6 October. Seven of our CNG players are currently away with their countries, representing England across the Under-17, Under-18 and Under-19 age groups, in addition to Scotland Under-19s. Hudson described the extended break as a great opportunity to focus on the personal development of each player. ‘Some of our players have gone on international duty and we're proud of that and we want to support that as much as we can,' said Hudson. 'The players that haven't, it also gives them an opportunity for them to train with the first team, so there’s a wide range of opportunities.' After the international break, CNG have four fixtures ahead of them in three different competitions. First up  is our final EFL Trophy group match against Reading. Chelsea are currently third in Southern Group C, following a penalty-shootout victory against Bristol Rovers and a narrow 2-1 defeat at the hands of Wycombe Wanderers. Previewing that vital cup clash against The Royals, Hudson said: ‘The first two performances in that competition have been strong. If we can take the learnings from the first two matches and put them together then hopefully we can get a positive result against Reading. We need to win to get out of the group. ‘It's very exciting because we have so many different challenges during that month and the variety of the games program pushes young players in different ways.’ As well as that meeting with Reading, the young Blues face Stoke and Liverpool in PL2, before a first European game in the UEFA Youth League at the end of October, in either Estonia or the Faroe Islands depending who prevails in the tie between Flora Tallinn and Havnar Boltfelag. Our head coach revealed that the players are relishing the opportunity to play abroad, labelling it a ‘phenomenal experience’. ‘The boys love the UEFA Youth League. It’s such a different experience that we can challenge ourselves against teams from all over the world. Our objective is to get through our qualifying rounds and enter the last 32.’ It’s early days in the 2026/27 season, but the Blues have made an encouraging start. Across all competitions, we’ve scored 16 goals in six matches. As we approach the end of the international break, the focus moves to the upcoming matches. Chelsea are looking to climb even higher in PL2, and progress in the EFL Trophy and UEFA Youth League. Hudson said: ‘There are going to be some highs, there are going to be some lows. There are some days that we've had more recently where things are starting to come together. 'My biggest message to them is they all have targets, goals that they want to achieve, and that’s brilliant. The way they're going to achieve those individual goals is by us being the best team that we can.’ There is still time to secure tickets for the EFL Trophy group stage clash against Reading at the Select Car Leasing Stadium. The match kicks off at 7pm on Tuesday 13 October. Chelsea fans wishing to attend the match will need to register for an account and then purchase tickets within block R31-R32 in the South Stand. Tickets for Reading vs Cobham Next Gen are available via this link Supporters can also watch the game via Sky Sports.
news.body_zh: 本赛季的第一次国际比赛日为科巴姆下一代主教练哈里·哈德森提供了回顾迄今为止的赛季并展望即将到来的各种比赛挑战的机会。科巴姆下一代队在 2026/27 赛季取得了良好的开局，赢得了过去三场联赛，并且仍有望晋级 EFL 奖杯。球队表现出色，已有六名球员进球。由于切尔西队的出色表现，三名球员被提名为 9 月份英超联赛 2 月最佳球员奖。雷吉·沃森、奇扎拉姆·埃森瓦塔和新加盟的里奥·布莱克都在八名提名者之列。在国际比赛暂停前，CNG 3-1 战胜同城死敌富勒姆，将连胜纪录扩大到三场，蓝军积 9 分排名第四。哈德森在回顾竞选的开始阶段时说：“这对孩子们来说是一个非常积极的开始。 CNG 团队在一起的时间越长，表演就越有凝聚力。 “我们对阵富勒姆的比赛表现非常出色。孩子们保持坚强、忠诚并专注于比赛计划。有几个进球是出色的团队进球，这对我们来说非常令人高兴。 CNG 队中有几位从 18 岁以下青年队中脱颖而出的年轻球员。哈德森透露，这背后的原因是我们“拥有出色的天赋，我们希望被推动，也值得被推动”。主教练补充道：“他们学习得非常快，在这个级别上踢的时间越长，他们就会变得越好，学得也越快。”我们对这座大楼拥有如此多的人才感到非常自豪。他们在天赋和努力之间取得了很好的平衡。”本赛季，9 月和 10 月的国际比赛日被合并为一个为期 16 天的时期，从 9 月 21 日到 10 月 6 日。我们的 7 名 CNG 球员目前正在离开自己的国家，除了代表苏格兰 U-19 队之外，还代表英格兰 U-17、U-18 和 U-19 年龄组。哈德森将延长休息时间描述为专注于每个球员个人发展的绝佳机会。 “我们的一些球员已经履行了国际义务，我们对此感到自豪，我们希望尽可能地支持这一点，”哈德森说。 “对于那些没有参加过训练的球员来说，这也给了他们和一线队一起训练的机会，所以有很多机会。”国际比赛日结束后，CNG 在三项不同的比赛中还有四场比赛。首先是我们对阵雷丁的最后一场 EFL Trophy 小组赛。切尔西目前在南部 C 组排名第三，在点球大战中战胜了布里斯托尔流浪者队，并以 2-1 险胜威科姆流浪者队。在展望与皇家队的这场至关重要的杯赛比赛时，哈德森说道：“那场比赛的前两场表现都很强劲。如果我们能够从前两场比赛中吸取教训并将其结合起来，那么我们希望能够在对阵雷丁的比赛中取得积极的结果。我们需要赢球才能小组出线。 “这非常令人兴奋，因为这个月我们面临着如此多不同的挑战，而各种各样的比赛计划以不同的方式推动着年轻球员。”除了与雷丁的会面之外，年轻的蓝军还将在 PL2 中面对斯托克城和利物浦，然后于 10 月底在爱沙尼亚或法罗群岛进行第一场欧洲青年联赛，具体地点取决于弗洛拉·塔林和哈夫纳尔·博尔特费拉格之间的比赛。我们的主教练透露，球员们很享受出国踢球的机会，称其为“非凡的经历”。 “孩子们喜欢欧洲青年联赛。这是一种非常不同的体验，我们可以与来自世界各地的团队一起挑战自己。我们的目标是通过预选赛并进入 32 强。” 虽然 2026/27 赛季还处于初期阶段，但蓝军已经取得了令人鼓舞的开局。在所有比赛中，我们在六场比赛中打进了 16 个进球。随着国际比赛日临近结束，焦点转向即将到来的比赛。切尔西希望在 PL2 中攀得更高，并在 EFL 奖杯和 UEFA 青年联赛中取得进展。哈德森说：“会有一些高峰，也会有一些低谷。最近的一些日子里，事情开始走到一起。 “我向他们传达的最重要的信息是，他们都有自己想要实现的目标，这太棒了。他们实现这些个人目标的方法就是让我们成为最好的球队。” 现在还有时间购买在 Select 汽车租赁体育场对阵雷丁的 EFL 杯小组赛门票。比赛将于 10 月 13 日星期二晚上 7 点开始。希望观看比赛的切尔西球迷需要注册一个帐户，然后在南看台的 R31-R32 街区购买门票。雷丁对阵科巴姆下一代的门票可通过此链接购买。支持者还可以通过天空体育观看比赛。

news.title: Chelsea's Ultimate Goal of the Season: Essien or Hazard? Vote now
news.title_zh: 切尔西本赛季的终极进球：埃辛还是阿扎尔？立即投票
news.body_en: And then there were two! We have narrowed down 20 strikes in our Ultimate Chelsea Goal of the Season competition to the final pairing, and now you need to choose which is the very best. Earlier in this international break, we split the winners of the Chelsea Goal of the Season award into four different groups. From there, eight goals advanced to the quarter-finals, four to the semis, and now the knockout stage has reached its finale. Our two finalists both had multiple entries in the competition, and it is their goals against Arsenal that have made it to the end. Michael Essien's thunderous strike that won the 2007 Goal of the Season award meets Eden Hazard's solo effort from a decade later. They are both legendary Chelsea goals, but which is your favourite? Watch them back in the video below and then have your say by voting in our poll! Vote for your Ultimate Chelsea Goal of the Season winner! Essien’s strike against Arsenal beat Ramires' chip in Barcelona in the semis. With the Blues behind to The Gunners at Stamford Bridge, Frank Lampard laid the ball off to the Ghanaian around 30 yards out and the midfielder let rip with a glorious swerving strike that flew into the top corner. Hazard's strike against Arsenal showcased everything Eden had to offer the Blues. Picking up possession inside his own half, the Belgian displayed strength to shrug off Francis Coquelin while retaining his balance to take on the Arsenal backline before calmly beating Petr Cech to register a sensational solo goal. Vote for your Ultimate Chelsea Goal of the Season winner! Return tomorrow (Tuesday) to find out which effort has won the Ultimate Chelsea Goal of the Season competition!
news.body_zh: 然后就有两个了！我们已经将切尔西赛季终极进球比赛中的 20 个进球缩小到了最后一对，现在您需要选择最好的一对。在国际比赛日早些时候，我们将切尔西赛季最佳进球奖的获得者分为四个不同的组。此后，8个进球晋级四分之一决赛，4个进球晋级半决赛，现在淘汰赛已经进入收官阶段。我们的两位决赛入围者都曾多次参加比赛，正是他们对阵阿森纳的进球才让他们走到了最后。迈克尔·埃辛 (Michael Essien) 的雷霆万钧的进球赢得了 2007 年赛季最佳进球奖，与十年后伊登·阿扎尔 (Eden Hazard) 的个人射门相得益彰。他们都是切尔西的传奇进球，但你最喜欢哪一个？在下面的视频中观看他们的表演，然后在我们的投票中投票发表您的意见！投票选出您心目中的切尔西赛季终极进球得主！半决赛中埃辛对阵阿森纳的进球击败了拉米雷斯在巴塞罗那的比赛中的进球。当蓝军在斯坦福桥落后枪手时，弗兰克·兰帕德将球传给了 30 码外的加纳人，这位中场球员一脚漂亮的转身射门，飞入球门上角。阿扎尔对阵阿森纳的进球展示了伊甸园为蓝军提供的一切。比利时人在本方半场拿到控球权后，展现出了力量，摆脱了弗朗西斯·科奎林的防守，同时保持平衡，挑战了阿森纳的后防线，然后冷静地击败了切赫，打进了一粒轰动一时的个人进球。投票选出您心目中的切尔西赛季终极进球得主！明天（周二）回来看看哪项努力赢得了切尔西赛季终极进球比赛！

news.body_en: A captain, leader, legend is the first name announced to play when a big rivalry will be reignited at Stamford Bridge on Saturday 27 March. Falling during Easter Weekend, the Chelsea Legends versus Tottenham Legends match will raise crucial funds for Chelsea Foundation and its work bringing people together, creating healthier lives and shaping brighter futures in our local communities. John Terry, who skippered the side to 15 major trophies in a momentous Blues career, will be turning back the clock to take on Tottenham once again, stirring memories of some of the club’s most historic battles against our London rivals. Indeed, JT scored against Spurs in the final of the 2015 League Cup, just one of the 717 matches he played, placing him third in the Chelsea all-time appearance tables. news.title: Keira Walsh on Chelsea's momentum and desire for more goals
news.title_zh: 凯拉·沃尔什谈切尔西的势头和对更多进球的渴望
news.body_en: After just nine matches, Keira Walsh has already equalled her tally of three goals last season, and now she’s hungry for even more. When the midfielder receives the ball on the edge of the penalty area, almost everyone inside the stadium now knows that she is going to shoot, but as head coach Sonia Bompastor remarked after our 3-0 win over West Ham on Sunday, there’s very little defenders can do about it. The emergence of Chelsea Academy graduate Lexi Potter has allowed Walsh to move out of her usual role as a deep-lying playmaker and advance, safe in the knowledge that her young team-mate can always be relied upon to sweep up any loose balls. Our previous performances had been so impressive that West Ham believed they must put every player behind the ball to stand any chance of taking anything from the game, and Walsh explained how we remained calm until Melvine Malard broke the deadlock after 38 minutes of perseverance. ‘It was important to finish the block with a win, and I thought it was a good team performance,’ she said. ‘We have played a lot of tough games, so we're really happy with that. ‘It's about staying disciplined and just trusting it's going to come. They’re a good team. They're hard to break down, and it was about waiting for our chances to come. In the second half, we played a little bit quicker with more intensity. ‘We were pressing more, trying to go forward when we won it back, and that was the difference.’ Walsh doubled our advantage in the final stages with a superb long-range effort. But rather than bask in the glory, the ever-professional midfielder rued a missed opportunity when she hit the post after 67 minutes. Such discontent explains everything about the standards she sets for herself. ‘I was a bit disappointed with the one that hit the post and didn't go in,’ she reflected. ‘I probably should have scored it. I'm enjoying my football, and I think we're playing really well as a team. ‘We've got each other's backs, and if it's not me scoring, it's someone else. I’m really happy to be in this team. We have good momentum; we’re in good form, and we probably don't want the break to come. I'm enjoying the games, and the more games I play, the happier I am.’ Sunday's win marked our sixth consecutive clean sheet in all competitions. Our success in attack has been built on those rock-solid foundations at the back. It’s been nine hours since the Blues last conceded a goal, something that Bompastor puts down to an increased focus on physical tenacity and a strong group mindset. Walsh explained more about this season’s focus. ‘I didn't know it was nine hours!’ she gasped. ‘It seems like a long time! It’s the way they're all playing at the back, to be honest. There’s a massive focus on first and second balls as well, and we're definitely doing better at that this year. ‘Whoever has played in our back three has been incredible, and Hannah (Hampton) too: the save she made in the Champions League shows the quality she brings. It’s a case of trusting each other's abilities and staying really compact as a team and fighting for each other. That sort of record is a team effort; it's not just the back four or five. ‘In the first half we were making a lot of balls to the front of the press from centre-back. A lot of opportunities come when you pick the second balls up, and that's always something that we really try and focus on, and I think we've done that really well. Hopefully that continues, and we keep building the momentum on this good run that we've just had.’
news.body_zh: 仅仅九场比赛之后，凯拉·沃尔什就已经追平了她上赛季的三粒进球，现在她渴望更多。当中场球员在禁区边缘接球时，几乎球场内的每个人都知道她要射门，但正如主教练索尼娅·邦帕斯特在周日我们 3-0 战胜西汉姆联队后所说，防守队员几乎无能为力。切尔西学院毕业生莱克西·波特的出现，让沃尔什摆脱了她通常作为一名后撤组织核心的角色，并安全地前进，因为她知道她的年轻队友总是可以依靠来扫除任何松散的球。我们之前的表现令人印象深刻，西汉姆联相信他们必须让每个球员都在球后，才有机会从比赛中获得任何东西，沃尔什解释了我们如何保持冷静，直到梅尔文·马拉德在坚持了 38 分钟后打破了僵局。 “以一场胜利结束本次比赛很重要，我认为这是一场很好的团队表现，”她说。 “我们踢了很多艰难的比赛，所以我们对此感到非常高兴。 ‘这是关于保持纪律并相信它会到来。他们是一支优秀的团队。他们很难被击垮，我们需要等待机会的到来。下半场我们打得更快了一些，强度也更大了。 “当我们赢回球权时，我们施加了更多压力，试图继续前进，这就是不同之处。”沃尔什在最后阶段凭借出色的远射将我们的优势扩大了一倍。但这位曾经的职业中场球员并没有沉浸在荣耀之中，而是在第 67 分钟击中门柱时后悔了自己错失的良机。这种不满解释了她为自己设定的标准的一切。 “我对那个击中门柱但没有进的球感到有点失望，”她回忆道。 “我可能应该进球。我很享受我的足球，我认为我们作为一个团队踢得非常好。 “我们互相支持，如果不是我进球，那就是别人。我真的很高兴能加入这个团队。我们势头良好；我们的状态很好，我们可能不希望休息到来。我很享受比赛，我踢的比赛越多，我就越高兴。周日的胜利标志着我们在所有比赛中连续第六次不失球。我们进攻的成功是建立在后防线坚如磐石的基础上的。距离蓝军上次失球已经过去九个小时了，邦帕斯特将这归因于对身体韧性和强大团队心态的更加关注。沃尔什详细解释了本赛季的重点。 “我不知道已经九个小时了！”她喘着气说。 ‘看来已经很久了啊！老实说，这就是他们在后场的比赛方式。第一球和第二球也受到了极大的关注，今年我们在这方面肯定做得更好。 “无论谁在我们的三后卫中踢球，都令人难以置信，汉娜（汉普顿）也是如此：她在冠军联赛中所做的扑救表明了她所带来的品质。这是一个信任彼此能力、保持团队紧密并为彼此而战的例子。这种记录是团队努力的成果；不仅仅是后四名或后五名。 “上半场我们从中后卫向逼抢前送出很多球。当你接住第二个球时，就会有很多机会，这始终是我们真正尝试和关注的事情，我认为我们做得非常好。希望这种情况能够继续下去，我们在刚刚取得的良好进展的基础上继续保持势头。”

news.title: Chelsea Diary: Premier League return takes centre stage
news.title_zh: 切尔西日记：英超回归成为焦点
news.body_en: Premier League football returns to Stamford Bridge this week, while exclusive interviews, international action and Academy fixtures also feature across the official Chelsea website and the Chelsea Official App. Here is what to look out for from Monday 5 October to Sunday 11 October, as Xabi Alonso’s side prepare to host Bournemouth and the final Chelsea players on international duty complete their schedules. The week begins with Keira Walsh reflecting on Chelsea Women’s 3-0 win at West Ham United. Our Ultimate Goal of the Season competition has reached its finale, while in the evening there is international action. Mike Penders and Romeo Lavia’s Belgium visit Maxence Lacroix's France in the UEFA Nations League. We will bring you updates on any Chelsea players who feature for their countries. The extended international break concludes when Emiliano Martinez and Valentin Barco’s Argentina host Benin in their final friendly, while England take on Czechia in the Nations League. There is also Under-21 international action, with Josh Acheampong's England side facing the Republic of Ireland in their UEFA European Championship qualifier, while Geovany Quenda and Portugal Under-21s meet Czechia. Look out for our final updates on the Blues involved and a round-up of the international window. With no senior or Academy fixture scheduled for the Blues, attention turns towards the weekend. We will continue to bring you the latest news from Cobham as the returning internationals link back up with their club team-mates. The Blues' last Premier League outing came at Brentford on 18 September, before the extended international break created a longer-than-usual pause in domestic action. Chelsea will now be looking to return to winning ways when Bournemouth visit Stamford Bridge. The build-up to Chelsea’s Premier League meeting with Bournemouth gathers pace. Our preview coverage will set the scene for the Blues’ first club fixture following the extended international break. We will also hear from summer signing Pep Chavarria in an exclusive interview, giving supporters the chance to get to know more about the defender and his experiences since joining the Blues. Alonso will face the media at Cobham ahead of Chelsea’s Premier League return. Supporters can follow the head coach’s press conference live on the official Chelsea website and the Chelsea Official App, with all the key talking points and team news to follow. We will continue our build-up to Chelsea versus Bournemouth with the latest from both camps, key statistics and everything supporters need to know before the game. It is a double-header as the action returns. The Under-18s begin the day by hosting Manchester United at Cobham, with kick-off at 11am. CFC+ subscribers can watch the game live on the official Chelsea website and Chelsea Official App. Then the focus moves to Stamford Bridge, where Chelsea host Bournemouth in the Premier League at 3pm. As ever, supporters can follow all the build-up, team news and live action in our Chelsea vs Bournemouth Match Centre on the official Chelsea website and Chelsea Official App. We will have minute-by-minute updates, live commentary, the match report and reaction from Stamford Bridge, along with all the best post-match content. Alonso and his players will be looking to make a positive return after the extended international break, with the Cherries providing the opposition in SW6. We will continue to bring you reaction from Saturday’s Premier League fixture, including highlights, analysis and interviews from Stamford Bridge, as well as highlights of the Under-18s’ meeting with Manchester United.

news.title: Midfielder voted as your Star of the Match against West Ham!
news.title_zh: 中场球员被评选为您对阵西汉姆联队的比赛之星！
news.body_en: Chelsea Women continued their excellent start to the new season with a 3-0 victory away at West Ham on Sunday, and Blues fans have voted for their standout performer. A first-half strike from Melvine Malard, plus goals from Keira Walsh and Maika Hamano, secured the three points in Dagenham on Sunday before our players left for international duty. This was our sixth consecutive clean sheet in all competitions, and the victory left us just two points shy of Manchester City at the top of the Women's Super League table. Walsh has been voted as your Star of the Match, earning a 53 per cent share of the votes for another brilliant strike and her all-round performance in her slightly more attacking role. Coming in second place with 27 per cent of the votes was Lucy Bronze for another hard-working performance at the back, while Melvine Malard took third position with 14 per cent of the overall tally for her superb turn and finish to open the scoring after 38 minutes.
news.body_zh: 周日，切尔西女足客场 3-0 战胜西汉姆联队，延续了新赛季的出色开局，蓝军球迷投票选出了她们表现出色的球员。梅尔文·马拉德（Melvine Malard）上半场的进球，加上凯拉·沃尔什（Keira Walsh）和麦卡·滨野（Maika Hamano）的进球，周日在达根纳姆（Dagenham）确保了我们的球员前往国际比赛之前获得三分。这是我们在各项赛事中连续第六次不失球，这场胜利使我们仅落后女超积分榜榜首的曼城两分。沃尔什被选为本场比赛之星，她以 53% 的得票率凭借另一次精彩的进球以及在进攻性稍强的角色中的全面表现而被选为本场比赛之星。露西·布朗兹（Lucy Bronze）以 27% 的得票率位居第二，她在后场的表现也很努力，而梅尔文·马拉德（Melvine Malard）凭借出色的转身和 38 分钟后首开纪录，以 14% 的得票率位居第三。

news.title: Internationals: Hato gets minutes in Netherlands win
news.title_zh: 国际比赛：哈托在荷兰队获胜中获得上场时间
news.body_en: Jorrel Hato played his first game of this international window as the Netherlands defeated Serbia 2-1 in the UEFA Nations League. Hato was introduced by Xavi on the hour, at which point the game in Eindhoven was locked at 1-1. Teun Koopmeiners' opener after 31 minutes was swiftly cancelled out by Mihajlo Cvetkovic. Not long after Hato entered the fray, Joshua Zirkzee scored the winning goal, with the Blues defender completing all 21 passes he attempted during his time on the pitch. The Dutch held on to move top of their Nations League group as they seek a spot in next year's knockout rounds. They play Greece and Germany in their final two fixtures in November. Elsewhere, Pedro Neto was an unused sub as Portugal defeated Norway 2-1 to make it four wins out of four in the Nations League in this window. They will guarantee a quarter-final berth if they avoid defeat against Denmark - who beat Wales tonight - in their next game. Earlier on Sunday, Reggie Watson scored a penalty for England Under-17s but they were beaten 3-2 by Germany in their final game of this window.
news.body_zh: 乔雷尔·哈托（Jorrel Hato）在欧洲国家联赛中踢了他本次国际比赛的首场比赛，帮助荷兰队以 2-1 击败塞尔维亚队。哈托在比赛进行到一小时时由哈维换下，此时埃因霍温的比赛战成1-1。第 31 分钟后，Teun Koopmeiners 的首开纪录很快就被 Mihajlo Cvetkovic 取消。哈托加入战斗后不久，约书亚·齐尔克泽攻入致胜一球，这位蓝军后卫完成了他在场上尝试的全部 21 次传球。荷兰队在国联小组中保持领先地位，寻求明年淘汰赛的席位。他们将在 11 月的最后两场比赛中对阵希腊和德国。其他方面，佩德罗·内托作为替补未上场，带领葡萄牙2-1击败挪威，在本窗口期的欧国联四场比赛中取得四胜。如果他们能避免在下一场比赛中输给今晚击败威尔士的丹麦队，他们将确保进入四分之一决赛。周日早些时候，雷吉·沃森 (Reggie Watson) 为英格兰 U-17 队打入点球，但他们在本窗口最后一场比赛中以 3-2 被德国队击败。

news.title: Sonia Bompastor on finding a way to win and praise for Potter
news.title_zh: 索尼娅·邦帕斯特 (Sonia Bompastor) 寻找获胜方法并对波特表示赞扬
news.body_en: Sonia Bompastor explained how the Blues put together a 3-0 win over West Ham and described Chelsea Academy graduate Lexi Potter as a 'starter' for the team. A clinical finish from Melvine Malard seven minutes from half-time saw us take the lead, while goals in the final ten minutes of the match from Keira Walsh and Maika Hamano completed a dominant display against the Hammers. This was our sixth consecutive clean sheet. Today's game was played at the end of a gruelling 11 days during which time we faced Austria Vienna and Arsenal at home before away matches against Lyon and West Ham. 'When you are Chelsea, you need to find different ways to win the games,' said Bompastor after the 3-0 victory. 'Today was about winning. We knew coming into this game that it was the last one in a really intense and condensed block: many fixtures, big games, and also a lot of travel. 'We weren’t as fresh as we would have liked to have been, but we found a way to win. We didn't concede much against this team, and we know they were probably looking to hurt us in transition. 'We knew coming into this game we had to be a little bit patient because we were going to face a team that would defend with a back five today, a low block, so the spaces were not always open. 'So we stayed strong; we scored a really important goal in the first half, we kept the clean sheet, and we were able to break them in the second half.' The Blues head coach introduced Lexi Potter at half-time in place of Sjoeke Nusken. The 20-year-old has impressed with some strong displays alongside Keira Walsh in midfield, so much so that Potter will now join up with the senior England side for the first time. Bompastor linked a more controlled second-half performance with Potter's introduction. She even went so far as to say that the Academy graduate had won a place among Chelsea's starters, before also praising Walsh's impact against West Ham. 'As you could see, when Lexi is playing for our team, she is really good right now,' she explained. 'She brings calmness; she brings quality on the ball. At the level she's performing right now, she's a starter for us. There is no doubt about that. 'We controlled the ball more in the second half, and the quality we had on the ball was better as well. With Lexi being on the pitch, it helps a lot. 'Keira is playing a little bit higher than probably last season. It helps us a lot in terms of creating opportunities. We know how good she is when she is at the edge of the box; even if the opposition knows what she’s going to do, her shot is so great that she’s able to score. 'And right now it's good to have a player who is confident and brings us the solution to scoring goals. That's really important.'
news.body_zh: 索尼娅·邦帕斯特 (Sonia Bompastor) 解释了蓝军如何 3-0 战胜西汉姆联队，并将切尔西学院毕业生莱克西·波特 (Lexi Potter) 描述为球队的“首发”。半场结束后 7 分钟，梅尔文·马拉德 (Melvine Malard) 的冷静射门让我们取得了领先，而凯拉·沃尔什 (Keira Walsh) 和麦卡·滨野 (Maika Hamano) 在比赛最后 10 分钟的进球完成了对铁锤队的统治性表现。这是我们连续第六次零失球。今天的比赛是在艰苦的 11 天之后进行的，这期间我们主场对阵奥地利维也纳和阿森纳，然后客场对阵里昂和西汉姆联。 “当你是切尔西队的时候，你需要找到不同的方式来赢得比赛，”邦帕斯特在3-0获胜后说道。 “今天是关于胜利的。我们知道，进入这场比赛后，这是一场真正紧张而紧凑的比赛中的最后一场：许多赛程、大型比赛，还有大量的旅行。 “我们并没有像我们希望的那样充满活力，但我们找到了获胜的方法。我们在对阵这支球队时并没有丢太多球，而且我们知道他们可能想在攻防转换中伤害我们。 “我们知道进入这场比赛我们必须有点耐心，因为今天我们将面对一支用五后卫防守的球队，一个低位防守，所以空间并不总是开放的。 “所以我们保持坚强；我们在上半场打进了一个非常重要的进球，我们保持了不失球，并在下半场打破了对手。”蓝军主教练在半场休息时用莱克西·波特代替了肖克·努斯肯。这位20岁的球员在中场与凯拉·沃尔什并肩作战时的出色表现给人留下了深刻的印象，以至于波特现在将首次与英格兰成年队联手。邦帕斯特将下半场更加受控的表现与波特的上场联系起来。她甚至说这位青训毕业生已经在切尔西的首发中赢得了一席之地，然后还赞扬了沃尔什在对阵西汉姆联队的比赛中的表现。 “正如你所看到的，当莱克西为我们球队效力时，她现在真的很棒，”她解释道。 “她带来平静；她给球带来了质量。以她现在的表现来说，她是我们的先发球员。毫无疑问。 “下半场我们控球能力更强，控球质量也更好。有莱克西在场上，这很有帮助。 “凯拉的表现比上赛季可能要高一些。它在创造机会方面对我们有很大帮助。当她处于禁区边缘时，我们知道她有多出色；即使对手知道她要做什么，她的射门也非常出色，能够得分。 “现在拥有一名充满自信并为我们带来进球解决方案的球员是件好事。这真的很重要。

news.title: Match report: West Ham United 0-3 Chelsea Women
news.title_zh: 赛报：西汉姆联0-3切尔西女足
news.body_en: Goals from Melvine Malard, Keira Walsh and Maika Hamano sealed a valuable victory away to West Ham United on Sunday afternoon. Coming straight into today's clash with West Ham after Wednesday's tough battle against Lyon was always going to be a big ask for the Blues. It was therefore no surprise that it was tough to find a way through during the opening exchanges as we were unable to create any clear-cut chances. Our pressing paid off after 38 minutes, when Sjoeke Nusken pounced on some slack short passing from the Hammers in midfield, setting up Melvine Malard with her back to goal. The striker did not need to be asked twice to turn and finish, putting us ahead at the break with a fine strike. There was not much action at either end for long periods of the second half, but after some changes from Sonia Bompastor, we were able to extend our advantage. A trademark effort from Walsh from the edge of the penalty area was followed by a header from Maika Hamano, both goals created by Alyssa Thompson on the left. At the end of a gruelling period of fixtures, this was the best way to finish before the international break: a 3-0 victory and our sixth clean sheet in a row during a match where West Ham produced nothing in the final third of the pitch. Bompastor made just two alterations from our impressive 0-0 draw away at Lyon in midweek, switching Lexi Potter and Thompson for Sandy Baltimore and Hamano, the Japan international making her first start of the season. Erin Cuthbert made the matchday squad for the first time since being announced as Chelsea captain, having completed her recovery from an injury sustained whilst on international duty with Scotland during the summer. And the Blues started the game in Dagenham with typical intent. Ellie Carpenter stormed down the right wing and got her cross away, forcing the home side to clear their lines quickly. And when Walsh made a run down the channel and played a diagonal ball to Nusken in the box, the Chelsea number six couldn't quite keep her shot down as she slid in to meet the cross. Carpenter won a corner on the half-hour mark with a powerful half-volley, which ricocheted off a West Ham defender. But the Blues were struggling to make a real impact in the final third, with no shots on target to show for 64 per cent possession and 16 touches in the opposition box. Up until that point, striker Malard hadn't had much of a sniff on goal. Yet when she got a chance, she took it with a clinical finish to put us in front eight minutes before half-time. The opportunity came from a West Ham free-kick in the midfield area. Nusken, sensing a moment's hesitation, used the press to steal the ball from the opposition and strode forward, with the ball finding Malard. The number nine received it with her back to goal, but stood strong, turned and stroked her finish into the bottom corner. We headed in at the interval with the one-goal advantage, and the home side had failed to take a single shot on goal in the opening 45 minutes. Neither side was able to fashion a clear chance after the restart, but just after the hour mark the Blues came alive once more. Some neat interplay on the edge of the box between Wieke Kaptein, Malard and Walsh was only lacking the finish to make it 2-0. Bompastor then shuffled the pack in attack, bringing on Aggie Beever-Jones and Alyssa Thompson in place of Baltimore and goalscorer Malard. The fresh impetus saw us go close when Beever-Jones charged down the right flank, playing the ball square to Kaptein on the edge of the area. Walsh then took her trademark shot from range, crashing her attempt onto the right-hand post. A 1-0 victory wouldn't have done Chelsea's dominance justice, and after looking dangerous from the edge of the area all game, Walsh finally got her goal and added our second of the afternoon. Thompson jinked her way towards goal from the left-hand side before playing a short sideways pass for Kaptein. The Netherlands international quickly shifted the ball to Walsh, and the midfielder used her tried and tested technique to fire the ball into the bottom corner. The strike put the match beyond reasonable doubt against a side who had still not registered a single shot on goal. Our third of the afternoon came from another of Thompson's runs down the left. This time, the American took a shot, which was saved before Beever-Jones picked up the loose ball and steered it towards Hamano, who was able to head home at the far post. Substitute McCabe whipped in a corner right under the crossbar, with keeper Constance Picaud-Inconnu only just managing to tip it over. The final whistle blew with no shots and no touches in our box from the home side. A truly dominant performance to end this block of fixtures. The victory, along with Tottenham's defeat to London City Lionesses, means we move into top spot in the WSL, pending Manchester City's result with Arsenal later this afternoon. Our players will now head off to represent their respective national teams during the international break. We return to action with a home game against Tottenham Hotspur at Stamford Bridge on 18 October. Chelsea:  Hampton, Carpenter, Bronze (c), Buchanan (McCabe 77), Buurman (Bjorn 86), Kaptein, Walsh, Nusken (Potter h-t), Baltimore (Thompson 65), Hamano, Malard (Beever-Jones 65)Unused substitutes: Peng, Cuthbert, Dragoni, James Scorers: Malard 38, Walsh 80, Hamano 87Booked: Kaptein 32 West Ham: Picaud-Inconnu, Codina, Siren, Belloumou, Kumagai, Zelem (c), Gago (Wandeler 69), Asseyi, Riesen (Endo 88), Cascarino, Puibel (Tennebo 81)Unused substitutes: Walsh, Dowsett, Wareing, Morgan, PeacockReferee: Sophie Dennington
news.body_zh: 周日下午，梅尔文·马拉德、凯拉·沃尔什和滨野麦卡的进球锁定了客场对阵西汉姆联队的宝贵胜利。在周三对阵里昂的艰苦战斗之后，直接进入今天与西汉姆联的比赛对蓝军来说总是一个很大的要求。因此，在开局交锋中很难找到出路也就不足为奇了，因为我们无法创造任何明确的机会。第 38 分钟后，我们的逼抢得到了回报，Sjoeke Nusken 接住了铁锤帮中场的短传，为梅尔文·马拉德 (Melvine Malard) 背身球门助攻。这名前锋不需要两次转身就完成射门，凭借一脚漂亮的射门让我们在中场休息时取得领先。下半场的很长一段时间里，双方都没有太多动作，但在索尼娅·邦帕斯托尔做出一些改变后，我们能够扩大我们的优势。沃尔什在禁区边缘打出标志性射门，随后滨野麦卡头球破门，这两粒进球均由左侧的阿丽莎·汤普森攻入。在经历了一段艰苦的比赛之后，这是国际比赛日之前最好的结束方式：我们以 3-0 取得胜利，并在西汉姆联队在最后三分之一的比赛中连续第六次不失球。周中我们客场0-0战平里昂的比赛中，邦帕斯特只做出了两次调整，用莱克西·波特和汤普森换下了桑迪·巴尔的摩和日本国脚滨野，这是她本赛季的首次首发。艾琳·库斯伯特 (Erin Cuthbert) 自被宣布担任切尔西队长以来首次入选比赛日阵容，她在夏季代表苏格兰国家队期间受伤，现已完全康复。蓝军在达格纳姆以典型的意图开始了比赛。埃莉·卡彭特从右翼猛冲过来，将她的传中球挡开，迫使主队迅速清理防线。当沃尔什沿着通道跑动并向禁区内的努斯肯打出斜线球时，这位切尔西六号球员在滑入接球时无法完全控制射门。卡彭特在半小时内凭借一记强力半凌空抽射赢得了角球，球被西汉姆联后卫击中。但蓝军在最后三分之一的比赛中难以发挥真正的作用，在对方禁区有 64% 的控球率和 16 次触球，没有射正。在那之前，前锋马拉德还没有对进球有太多的嗅觉。然而，当她有机会时，她以冷静的射门抓住了机会，在半场结束前八分钟让我们领先。机会来自西汉姆联中场的任意球。努斯肯察觉到了片刻的犹豫，利用压迫从对方手中抢断了球，大步向前，球传给了马拉德。九号球员背对球门接球，但她坚强地站了起来，转身将球射入球门底角。我们在中场休息时以一球优势头球破门，而主队在开场45分钟内一次都没能射正。比赛重新开始后，双方都未能创造出明显的机会，但就在一个小时之后，蓝军再次活跃起来。 Wieke Kaptein、Malard 和 Walsh 在禁区边缘巧妙的配合，只是缺少射门，将比分改写为 2-0。随后，邦帕斯特在进攻中重新调整了阵容，用阿吉·比弗-琼斯和阿丽莎·汤普森代替巴尔的摩和进球者马拉德。当比弗-琼斯从右翼冲锋，将球传给禁区边缘的卡普坦时，我们的新动力让我们逼近了比分。随后沃尔什进行了她标志性的远距离射门，击中了右侧门柱。 1-0 的胜利并不能体现切尔西的统治地位，整场比赛在禁区边缘看起来都很危险，沃尔什终于进球了，为我们打进了下午的第二粒进球。汤普森从左侧冲向球门，然后为卡普坦进行了一次短侧传球。荷兰国脚迅速将球传给沃尔什，沃尔什用她久经考验的技术将球射入底角。这一粒进球让这场比赛毫无疑问地战胜了一支还没有射门的球队。下午的第三个进球来自汤普森的另一次左路跑动。这一次，美国人射门，但在比弗-琼斯捡起球并将其引向滨野之前，射门被扑出，滨野在远门柱头球破门。 替补出场的麦凯布在横梁正下方开出角球，门将康斯坦斯·皮考德-因康努刚刚将球打翻。终场哨响了，主队没有射门，也没有触球。一场真正具有统治力的表现结束了这一系列的比赛。这场胜利，加上托特纳姆热刺队输给伦敦城狮队，意味着我们将跻身女超级联赛榜首，等待今天下午晚些时候曼城对阵阿森纳的结果。我们的球员现在将在国际比赛日期间代表各自的国家队出发。 10 月 18 日，我们将在斯坦福桥主场迎战托特纳姆热刺队。切尔西：汉普顿、卡彭特、青铜（c）、布坎南（麦凯布 77）、布尔曼（比约恩 86）、卡普坦、沃尔什、努斯肯（波特 h-t）、巴尔的摩（汤普森 65）、滨野、马拉德（比弗-琼斯 65）未上场替补：彭、库斯伯特、德拉戈尼、詹姆斯 进球者：马拉德 38、沃尔什80、滨野 87 黄牌：卡普坦 32 西汉姆联：皮科-因康努、科迪纳、塞伦、贝卢穆、熊谷、泽勒姆（中）、加戈（万德勒 69）、阿塞伊、里森（远藤 88）、卡斯卡里诺、普伊贝尔（天内博 81）未上场替补：沃尔什、多塞特、韦林、摩根、孔雀裁判：索菲·丹宁顿
